settings.heading: Style notes
settings.content: Relaxed straight fit. Model is 5'7" wearing size M. Pairs with the matching dupatta and tapered pants.

settings.heading: Size & fit
settings.content: True to size. Between sizes? Size up or use complimentary made-to-measure. See the size chart for measurements.

settings.heading: Material & care
settings.content: 100% cotton mul, hand-dyed batik. Hand-wash cold separately, dry in shade, warm iron inside-out.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Ships in 24–48 hrs, delivered in 4–6 days. Easy 7-day returns on stock sizes. Made-to-measure orders are final sale.

settings.name: Ananya R.
settings.title: The fabric breathes beautifully
settings.body: Wore the indigo kurta set through a full workday in Bangalore heat and stayed cool. The batik is even richer in person. Made-to-measure fit was spot on.

settings.name: Meera K.
settings.title: Customization is a game-changer
settings.body: I am between sizes and always struggle. Sent my measurements and the dress fit like it was stitched for me. Will be back for the co-ords.

settings.name: Priya S.
settings.title: Beautiful, runs slightly long
settings.body: Gorgeous terracotta shade and lovely cotton. I am petite so I got it hemmed — would have loved a shorter option. Still a favourite in my closet.
